data.description: The tugboat is a boat you drive on low grade fuel, burning 19 a minute, so a full 500 tank lasts about 26 minutes. No vendor sells it. If you leave it on the water it starts drifting toward shore after 2 hours, and left alone it starts decaying after 24 hours and is gone 36 hours later, so don't count on it staying where you parked.
